0fa8744f4c69925b.description: Technical Product Growth Manager Experience: 3+ years Location: Remote Compensation: ₹10–12 LPA + ESOPs About The Date The Date Crew is building a human-first matchmaking platform for relationship-ready professionals. We don’t believe finding a life partner should be reduced to swipes, filters or endless profiles. We combine human judgment, psychology, technology and data to make matchmaking more thoughtful, efficient and effective. As we scale, some of our most interesting challenges sit at the intersection of technology, product, operations and human behaviour. And that’s exactly where this role comes in **The Role ** We are looking for a slightly unusual person. Someone technical, but not obsessed with writing code for the sake of writing code. Someone who sees a messy business problem and instinctively starts asking: * Why is this happening? * What does the data say? * Where exactly is the bottleneck? * Can this be solved with a process change? * Should we automate it? * Should we build a product for it? * Can AI solve part of it? What is the quickest way to test whether the solution actually works? You will work across different parts of The Date Crew and solve problems spanning matchmaking, product, sales, marketing, customer experience and internal operations. One week you could be improving how our matchmaking algorithm ranks profiles. Another week you could be figuring out why customers are dropping off at a particular stage of the sales funnel. The next problem could involve psychometric analysis, building an internal AI workflow, improving matchmaker productivity or automating a repetitive operational process. Your job is not simply to build what someone tells you to build. Your job is to understand the problem deeply and figure out the best way to solve it. **What You’ll Work On ** Examples of problems you may solve: Matchmaking & Recommendation Systems Improve the way profiles are ranked and recommended. Identify signals that actually predict compatibility. Analyse acceptance/rejection behaviour and improve recommendation quality. Build internal tools that help matchmakers make better decisions. Psychology & Compatibility Help structure psychometric or behavioural information. Explore how qualitative information can become useful product signals. Build tools that help our team better understand compatibility between two people. Sales & Growth Analyse funnel drop-offs. Identify why leads don't convert. Build tools or automations to help the sales team prioritise leads. Experiment with new ways of improving conversion. Operations Identify repetitive processes that should disappear. Build internal dashboards, automations and lightweight tools. Reduce operational errors and manual work. Improve how information flows between teams. AI & Automation Prototype AI agents and workflows. Connect APIs, LLMs, CRMs and internal systems. Use AI where it genuinely improves speed or decision-making—not because AI sounds cool. What We’re Looking For You probably have 3+ years of experience in engineering, product, automation, data or an early-stage startup environment. More importantly, you think like a builder. **You should be comfortable with: ** Breaking ambiguous problems into smaller pieces. Understanding APIs, databases and system architecture. Writing enough code to build working solutions. Using AI coding tools to prototype quickly. Vibe coding and stitching different tools/services together. Working with SQL or analysing data. Thinking in terms of metrics and outcomes. Building MVPs before building perfect systems. Talking to users and internal teams before deciding what to build. You don't necessarily need to be the world's best engineer. But you should understand technology deeply enough to know what is possible, what is difficult and what is unnecessarily complicated. **What Success Looks Like ** Within your first few months, we would expect you to: Identify high-impact problems independently. Develop clear hypotheses around those problems. Use data to validate them. Prototype solutions quickly. Work closely with the team using the solution. Measure whether the solution actually improved the metric. Kill ideas that don't work and iterate on the ones that do. Ultimately, your output isn't software. Your output is problems solved. Compensation ₹10–12 lakh per annum + ESOPs For the right person, this role can grow significantly as the product and technology organisation at The Date Crew evolves.

0fa9de44e2604ee3.description: Certa ([certa.ai](http://certa.ai)) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we’ve processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. At Certa, AI agents do real work for enterprise risk and procurement teams: Studio designs workflows, Data Agent answers questions over customer data, and Risk Agent assesses third parties. The model is the same one everyone can buy - the harness is what makes ours do the job reliably, safely, and cheaply, and you’ll own that harness. This isn’t a “build AI features” role: you own an agent end to end and you’re measured on whether it does the task - success rate, latency, cost per task, and what customers stop doing by hand. It’s a small team with high ownership, where you’ll work directly with PMs, design, and customers, and be trusted to make the call. ## What You’ll Do - **Own the agent loop:** Step control, planning, retries, error feedback, subagents, and parallel tool calls for long, multi-step tasks. - **Design tools & actions:** Build the tools, MCP servers, and skills our agents use - narrow, well-described, permissioned, and safe to call against customer data. - **Engineer context:** Decide what the model sees on every step - compaction, memory, retrieval-as-a-tool, and how agents read large enterprise records without drowning. - **Build evals that gate every change:** Golden sets, regression suites, and trace-based scoring wired into CI, so no prompt, model, or harness change ships blind. - **Own model choices & the runtime:** Route across models on capability, latency, and cost, running new model launches through the eval suite and re-tuning the harness when the frontier moves, with durable sessions, sandboxed execution, nested-trace observability, token budgets, and graceful fallbacks for multi-tenant enterprise customers. - **Own the backend systems:** Design services end to end (data model, APIs, storage choice, failure modes), build async pipelines (queues, workers, retries, idempotency, backpressure), and make them fast and cheap at scale (caching, batching, indexing, p95/p99 latency budgets) on multi-tenant AWS with isolation, least-privilege access, PII handling, and audit trails. - **Own it in production:** Write the design doc, weigh the trade-offs, defend them in review, and own the service in production. ## What Success Looks Like - **Day 30 - Backend:** Own one Studio backend service end to end and ship a production change (a new API, a pipeline fix, or a performance improvement) with a measurable result, such as a lower p95 latency or error rate, and join its on-call rotation. - **Day 60 - Fix:** Find the top failure mode of an existing agent from its traces and ship a fix that lifts its task success rate by a measurable amount on our eval set (target: +10 points). - **Day 90 - Build:** Ship one new agent capability or backend service you designed from scratch, live with at least one customer, with a written design doc and a target metric you set and hit. ## What You’ll Need - **Backend & system design:** 3+ years building production backend systems with strong system design - you’ve designed and scaled services under real load, picked the data stores, modeled the data, and handled async processing, queues, caching, idempotency, and failure in production. Python preferred. - **Shipped an agent:** You’ve shipped at least one LLM agent to real users and can explain its loop, its tools, its failure modes, and the numbers that showed it worked. - **Evals that change decisions:** You’ve built evals that changed a decision - you killed, shipped, or reworked something because the eval said so. - **Context & tool design instincts:** Strong instincts for context and tool design, able to say why an agent failed by reading its trace. - **Works with coding agents:** You use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as a core part of how you work, and have opinions about what makes a harness good. - **Owns outcomes:** A record of owning outcomes - you pick the metric, move it, and report honestly when it doesn’t move. - **Nice to have:** Built or contributed to an agent harness, framework, or orchestration layer (open source counts); enterprise B2B in a regulated domain (PII, audit trails, permissions, SOC 2); founder or founding-engineer experience; and any framework (LangGraph, Agent SDKs, Deep Agents) or none - we care about the judgment, not the library. ## Compensation and Benefits - **Compensation:** Top of market salary + bonuses and equity - **Time off:** 49 days paid time off - **Benefits:** PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans - **Growth:** Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus - **Team building:** Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world ## Location Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to: - London - San Francisco - Jaipur The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings. ## Why Certa - **Category leadership.** Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we’re defining the category, not following it. - **Industry recognition.** We’ve been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group’s 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards. - **A top place to work.** Certa was named one of Forbes’ Best Startup Employers in the US. We’re a fast-growing company where you’ll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter. - **Real scale with strong backing.** We’ve processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We’re well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C. We’re excited to meet you!
